test_title: PYST 123: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 23 Jan, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
A @ B means ‘A is the husband of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

A # B means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the sibling of B’.

If R % Y & D @ G # M, then M’s son-in-law is the ________ of R.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5df405191322742ae9fa10bc50efdb0cb5c7ddcf0421e61bb8812f46b9813d6.png] 

According to the given information, the family tree is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ece2f690b090e9f1a498bc3a6e2957514d339ed410578ea7c500e3a6e5757956.png] 

Here, we can see that M’s son-in-law is the sister’s son of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"sister’s son"**.
